text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama looks like she's been having a lot of fun lately. She's full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We're going to put in just as much effort ourselves, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I didn't know you two were comin' to watch!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam, your form today was fantastic. ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You must be hungry after running like that. Why don't you get changed so we can all go to that place that serves up Everest-sized bowls of soy and pork ramen?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It'll be our treat to you for working so very hard. ♪ What a good girl you are.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: My belly's not big enough to manage Everest-sized portions! And quit it with da "good girl" stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But yeah, I guess you could say I've been ridin' high!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Since I paired up with Trainer, it feels kinda like my body's been loosenin' up? And my runnin' and comebacks are gettin' sharper.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Not like my trainin's got anythin' to do with my gags, though!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Oh Tamtam, it's so nice to see you growing up. You're so big and strong now!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I think I'll follow your example. Maybe it's time for me to try two Everest bowls…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And I'll do the same and spoil you even more, Tamtam. ♪
